Subject: FinServe discovery — post-call recap and next steps

Team — quick recap from this morning's discovery with FinServe (Sofia + Rajiv + Lina on the call). High-level: they're interested in moving an initial proof-of-concept for a customer-service augmentation use case; primary constraints are procurement gating timelines and an internal compliance checklist (Lina).

Key takeaways:
- Economic buyer: Sofia Martinez (CFO) — cost/ROI is top decision axis.
- Procurement path: Rajiv (Procurement) expects vendor intake + SOW review; typical timeline 4–6 weeks after steering sign-off.
- Security: Lina Park will run a vendor questionnaire and wants a SOC2 summary + evidence for data handling.
- Decision criteria: 1) Cost per convo + reliability; 2) Data residency & retention policies; 3) Integration effort with FinServe infra.

Action items I propose (owner in parens):
- Send a concise post-call recap + ask for steering council attendees and date choices (Monica)
- Push our lightweight economic case (1-pager + slide deck) to highlight expected TCO improvements (Aditya)
- Share security checklist and vendor questionnaire we can prefill to speed procurement (Lauren)
